content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"The record has material gaps that should be filled before a merits decision. The investigator did not contact RMO6, who made or announced the denial, and RMO2 testified only to hearsay. The FY 2015 evaluation is missing. The record also does not show any undue hardship analysis: RMO4 declined to delineate the factors, so the denial rests on seven functions that Complainant apparently performed from Florida before the relocation. Management never answered his proposed temporary or alternative Miami assignments, and the individualized assessment is unclear. The claim that RMO4 pressured the FOHS doctor was not examined. There is also no comparator evidence for the productivity ratings behind the PIP and the 'Unacceptable' rating. The record does not support a reliable evaluation of the Agency's conclusion."}
